title: Implement plugin system for custom validators
description: Introduce an extensibility point so consumers can register custom field validators without modifying the core validation module: a plugin registers a named validator function and a schema declaration can reference it by name, with the core module resolving and invoking registered plugins at validation time.
acceptanceCriteria: Consumers can register a named custom validator without editing the core validation module's source.
A schema field referencing an unregistered validator name fails fast with a clear configuration error at schema-build time, not silently at request time.
Built-in validators continue to work unchanged after the plugin mechanism is introduced.
Two independently registered plugins do not interfere with each other's state.
Plugin validators receive the same context (field value, full object, path) as built-in validators.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run plugin-registration tests plus the full existing validator test suite to confirm no regression in built-ins.
groundTruth: A validator registry (name to function map) is consulted alongside built-in validators; schema construction resolves every referenced validator name against the registry immediately and throws a configuration error for any unresolved name before any request is validated.
